# WEC Pitwall

> Professional FIA World Endurance Championship analytics — live race status, standings, driver comparisons, championship battles, and circuit profiles.

## Pages

- [Home](https://wec-pitwall.vercel.app): Race countdown, live status, editorial hero
- [Schedule](https://wec-pitwall.vercel.app/schedule): Full 2024–2026 WEC calendar with status badges
- [Standings](https://wec-pitwall.vercel.app/standings): Driver & team championship standings by season/class
- [Circuits](https://wec-pitwall.vercel.app/circuits): All 8 WEC 2026 track profiles with details
- [Teams](https://wec-pitwall.vercel.app/teams): Team rosters and class listings
- [Driver Comparison](https://wec-pitwall.vercel.app/compare): Head-to-head driver analytics (auth required)
- [Championship Battle](https://wec-pitwall.vercel.app/championship): Title fight visualization (auth required)

## Tech Stack

React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Supabase, Sentry, PostHog

## Data

2026 season data sourced from Supabase. 2024–2025 historical data in static files.
